hook: In theory, gravitational phase evolution is distinguishable from classical mediators despite dephasing.
summary: In a dephased version of the Bose-Marletto-Vedral setup, the authors prove an exact finite-time difference between gravitational conditional-phase dynamics and any passive classical-mediator model, even when no entanglement forms. The difference survives some classical measurement and feedback. It is a theoretical result that depends on the chosen classical mediator models and on well-characterized local dephasing.
title: Testing non-classical gravitational phase dynamics under strong dephasing
